# ferentin_data_protection_profiles (Data Source)

List the built-in data-protection detector profiles (e.g. `US_PII`, `EXFILTRATION_DEFENSE`). Read-only catalog data, suitable for `for_each`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Plural — lists every built-in detector profile.
data "ferentin_data_protection_profiles" "all" {}

output "profile_names" {
  value = [for p in data.ferentin_data_protection_profiles.all.profiles : p.name]
}
```
